description: 给 AI 一根「教鞭」：在屏幕上画出箭头、方框、圆圈、文字标签，直接指给用户「点这里」。配合截图工具（先截图定位目标）与功能手册（先查功能在哪），AI 就能完成「你问在哪 → 我看一眼 → 画给你看」的闭环。指示器是**点击穿透**的透明覆盖层，不挡用户操作，几秒后自动消失。

mcpTools.name: point
mcpTools.description: Draw on-screen pointers (arrows / rectangles / circles / text labels) to show the user exactly where to click. The overlay is transparent and click-through — it never blocks the user's mouse, and fades out automatically after `duration` seconds. Coordinates are SCREEN-ABSOLUTE PHYSICAL PIXELS (same space as the screenshot tools' `meta.monitorOrigin` — see the computer-use skill for the conversion). Typical use: user asks "where is X?" → look it up in the gui-manual skill → screenshot to locate it → call this with an arrow/box pointing at it. Call with `clear: true` to remove pointers early.

arrows.description: Arrows pointing AT a target. `toX/toY` is the tip (what you're pointing at).

toX.description: Tip X — the point being indicated

toY.description: Tip Y — the point being indicated

rects.description: Rectangles around a target (e.g. a button).

label.description: Optional corner badge, e.g. a step number "1"

circles.description: Circles around a small target (e.g. an icon).

labels.description: Free text labels (e.g. "① 先点这里").

duration.description: Seconds before auto-fade (default 8). Use 0 to keep them until cleared.

dim.description: Dim the whole screen so the pointers stand out (default true). Set false when pointing at something the user must read.

monitor.description: Monitor index to draw on (default: primary). Use the screenshot tool's meta.monitorIndex.

clear.description: true = remove existing pointers and draw nothing new.
